response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.80. It is a proposal only; a human decides.

**Three facts that drove it:**
1. T-X1005-03 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It re-quotes a 1064 bid and a 5322 ask together every ~3 seconds. Each pair is cancelled at the same timestamp and re-placed one tick lower as the touch falls.
2. There is no opposite-side (BUY) execution at all. 17504 executed on its own SELL quotes (about 11% of submitted), and no single order reached 3x depth (the maximum is 2.19x). There is no benefit, so feature (b) is absent, and the asks were genuinely trading, so feature (a) is absent.
3. There is no public event, no repetition flag and no prior alert, and the order-to-trade ratio is 4.25 against a typical 35 for the desk.

**What would change my mind:** a BUY execution by this trader made while a large SELL quote rested, followed by a price move in his favour that reverted after the cancel. The cancel symmetry of 0.37 comes from the bid being much smaller than the ask. I did not check that further.
